top.line: An experiment in letting an agent team keep building topical sites, each live for its moment.

in-short.line: Topical sites built fast, a weekly loop within a budget, every fact sourced, a first calendar.

why.line: Arrows in the quiver: traffic, workflows shown working, and an agent team on a long-running job.

loop.line: Propose five a week, pick, build in a day within a budget, live for a moment, count; rules in the policy.

calendar.line: GTA VI today, the Web Summit pieces, the book; Christmas posting, an advent of tools, the Kickstarter; New Year, AI models, the Pi.

learn.line: How good its ideas are, how it builds under a budget, what draws people, what fails over weeks.

limits.line: No sites yet; GTA VI's date as announced; the Galaxy and voice demo for later.

sources.line: The request to the sovereign website team, and the tools, factory and appliance pieces.
